Services

Working better together.
With digital tools and AI.

Everything we do revolves around office work – for leaders and teams in medium-sized businesses. We want people there to enjoy their work and see what they achieve – instead of groaning under overload.

Most teams know their subject well. But their expertise often gets buried under cumbersome ways of working: communication, agreements and workload are not under control. That is where we come in – with better ways of working, the right digital tools and AI.

Every service combines a format and a topic. And a conversation with you. You can see what it costs further down.

Talk

Training

We bring a tool or a method and teach it – interactively and as equals.

Advantages
Everyone learns the same thing and can apply it straight away.
Disadvantages

Workshop

You bring your questions and problems. Together we work out solutions – with our knowledge and our tools.

Advantages
Solutions for your situation; everyone gets a say.
Disadvantages
Only for small groups; needs specific questions.
A good fit if …
You have specific questions or friction that you want to resolve together.
Less suitable if …
The topic is still new to everyone – then start with a talk or training.
Online or on site?
Works well online if everyone has their camera on; more intensive on site.

Coaching

One-to-one advice at the workplace. We listen – and come up with ideas.

Advantages
Tailored entirely to your work and your tools.
Disadvantages
Only reaches individuals.
A good fit if …
Individuals want to noticeably improve the way they work.

one organisation

Organisational consulting

We analyse with you how work is done today, design together how it can be done better and help you put it into practice.

Advantages
The whole picture: processes across roles and departments.
Disadvantages
Takes time and a willingness to question familiar habits.
A good fit if …
Processes get stuck between teams, and you want to change something fundamental.
Less suitable if …
You are only looking for orientation for now – then a talk is better.
Online or on site?
Consulting always starts on site: kick-off and getting to know each other at your premises. After that, much can be done online.

Ongoing support

The measures have been decided. We stay on the case, follow up and give input – as partners who hold you to it.

Advantages
The change doesn’t get lost in day-to-day business.
Disadvantages
Only works if you want to put things into practice yourself.
A good fit if …
After a workshop or consulting, what was decided should really become part of everyday work.
Less suitable if …
It is still open what should change – then start with a workshop or consulting.
Online or on site?
Works well online, supplemented by on-site meetings.
for individuals, teams or everyone

Tool development

We build the tool you are missing – with AI too. Where there is no software, where your software lacks something or where an overloaded Excel spreadsheet needs replacing.

Advantages
The gap is closed; the excuse ‘we don’t have the right tool’ is gone.
Disadvantages
You still have to use the tool yourself.
A good fit if …
A specific gap in your tools is slowing your work down.
Less suitable if …
The process itself is still unclear – then simplify it together first.
Online or on site?
Development mostly online, together with you.

Individual people · you talk

Online or on site?

On site, the energy is higher: everyone is involved, everyone is challenged. Online is more flexible and saves travel. Both have their place.

These days we lean towards ‘on site’ again, at least at the beginning. For longer projects we meet at your premises to start with – after that, much can be done online.

Prices

A day
is a day.

Preparation and follow-up are included in the day rate, travel time in the flat fee. So you know in advance what it costs – with no hidden hours.

Consulting, training, workshop

€1,500 – €2,500 per day

  • Depending on the size of your business. Online or on site.
  • Preparation and follow-up are included in the day rate.
  • Training and workshops: day rate for a group of up to 15 people.
  • Half a day costs half.
  • Consulting and coaching can also be billed by the hour, pro rata to the day rate.

On-site work

from €450 per visit

  • Flat travel fee once per visit: €450 in Germany, €550 elsewhere in Europe.
  • Travel time and the first night are included.
  • Each additional day on site: €200 for accommodation and meals.

All prices net. Talks have their own fees: Andrea’s talks.
